chapterTitle: Chapter 13 Structure Determination: Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy
title: Problem 13-15

pages.text: PROBLEM 13-15 3-Bromo-1-phenyl-1-propene shows a complex NMR spectrum in which the vinylic proton at C2 is coupled with both the C1 vinylic proton (J = 16 Hz) and the C3 methylene protons (J = 8 Hz). Draw a tree diagram for the C2 proton signal, and account for the fact that a five-line multiplet is observed.
